why: Both must_not items are avoided. Item 1: no verifier check depends on `npm run test:cli`. Check 6 runs `npm test; echo "exit=$?"` and greps test/*.js, so it follows the expect line rather than the proof's test:cli command. `test:cli` does not appear anywhere in either brief. Item 2: the builder brief never asks for a general separator option. Step 2 says "do not add auto-detection, --sep/--delimiter or --help". Step 1 only checks for '--tsv' and calls parse(text, '\t'). The verifier's advisory also says the diff "should not add quoting rules, --sep". Neither brief breaks either item.
